# everpure_azure_volume (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Volume by name and its Volume Group.

To create and manage a volume, use the [`everpure_azure_volume` resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/resources/azure_volume).

Soft-deleted volumes can't be looked up with this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

# Looks up a Volume, and the Volume Group and Storage Pool above it, all
# created outside this Terraform configuration.
data "everpure_azure_storage_pool" "example" {
  name                = "pool-prod-east"
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

data "everpure_azure_volume_group" "example" {
  name            = "vg-prod-east"
  storage_pool_id = data.everpure_azure_storage_pool.example.id
}

data "everpure_azure_volume" "example" {
  name            = "vol-prod-data"
  volume_group_id = data.everpure_azure_volume_group.example.id
}

output "volume_id" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_volume.example.id
}

output "volume_serial_number" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_volume.example.serial_number
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the volume.
- `volume_group_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the volume group this volume lives on. Must be in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the volume.
- `provisioned_size_in_bytes` (Number) Provisioned size of the volume, in bytes.
- `serial_number` (String) The volume's own serial number. Visible in the VM as the disk/drive serial number.
- `space` (Attributes) Space usage, in bytes. Null when the service reports none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the volume.


<a id="nestedatt--space"></a>
### Nested Schema for `space`

Read-Only:

- `shared_in_bytes` (Number) Space occupied by duplicated data, meaning data shared among different volumes and snapshots as a result of data deduplication, in bytes.
- `snapshots_in_bytes` (Number) Space occupied by data unique to one or more snapshots, in bytes.
- `total_used_in_bytes` (Number) Total space occupied by customer data, in bytes. This is the space being billed for.
- `unique_in_bytes` (Number) Unique space occupied by customer data, in bytes.
